institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York

remedy.notes: Order of Judge Cathy Seibel, 14 September 2026, resolving a sua sponte Rule 11 order to show cause. The forward-looking GenAI certification requirement is the distinguishing feature: it binds counsel on any future filing rather than only in this case, and the corpus holds no comparable standing disclosure remedy. The order places the conduct in the middle of a three-part hallucination taxonomy, fabricated quotations attributed to real decisions rather than wholly nonexistent cases. The denial of opposing counsel’s fee requests turns on the procedural posture, not on the gravity of the conduct.
